name: field-read
source:
class Box
public x: number
function increment(self, amount: number): number
self.x+=amount
return self.x
end
function twice(value: number): number return value*2 end
function zero(): Box return Box {x=0} end
function __tostring(self): string return tostring(self.x) end
end
local item=Box {x=1}
assert(item.x==1)
